substrate.config.purpose: Runtime settings for scoring, retention, scheduling and pipeline behavior.

substrate.raw_clan_profile.purpose: Original clan profile responses before normalization.
substrate.raw_clan_profile.lifecycle: Transient API evidence. purge_raw_logs, invoked by nightly maintenance.

substrate.raw_clan_members.purpose: Original clan roster responses; a trigger turns these into members and players.
substrate.raw_clan_members.lifecycle: Transient API evidence. purge_raw_logs, invoked by nightly maintenance.

substrate.raw_river_race.purpose: Original current river race responses used to build war activity.
substrate.raw_river_race.lifecycle: Transient API evidence. purge_raw_logs, invoked by nightly maintenance.

substrate.raw_war_log.purpose: Original completed war responses, including large nested API payloads.
substrate.raw_war_log.lifecycle: Transient API evidence. purge_raw_logs, invoked by nightly maintenance.

substrate.governance_telemetry.purpose: Execution diagnostics, stage audit logs and validation results.
substrate.governance_telemetry.lifecycle: Bounded operational history. GOVERNANCE_TELEMETRY_KEEP_DAYS controls nightly pruning.

substrate.pipeline_heartbeat.purpose: Latest state, success and failure timestamps for each backend component.
substrate.pipeline_heartbeat.lifecycle: Current state, overwritten by component identity. Not a complete incident history.

substrate.cron_run_daily.purpose: Compact daily summaries of scheduled job execution, preserved before raw cron history is deleted.
substrate.cron_run_daily.lifecycle: Aggregated operational history. CRON_ROLLUP_KEEP_DAYS controls pruning.

substrate.discovery_cache.purpose: Recently scanned clans, preventing repeat work during recruit discovery.
substrate.discovery_cache.lifecycle: Transient cache. purge_stale_discovery_cache, invoked by nightly maintenance.

substrate.discovery_anchors.purpose: Clan search anchors and scan yield, used to direct recruit discovery.
substrate.discovery_anchors.lifecycle: Search state. Review anchor rotation and eviction separately from the scan cache.

substrate.headhunter_epoch_state.purpose: Scanner epoch progress and retry state for the five-minute guard.
substrate.headhunter_epoch_state.lifecycle: Current control state. Historical details belong in telemetry.

drivers.clans.lifecycle: Domain entities. Review ownership and clan retirement policy.

drivers.players.purpose: Shared player identity and profile, referenced by members, recruits, battles and voyages.
drivers.players.lifecycle: Domain entities. purge_orphan_players removes identities without its recognized references; dependent foreign keys cascade.

drivers.members.purpose: Clan membership, current role, activity and membership dates.
drivers.members.lifecycle: Current and recently inactive membership. purge_inactive_members runs nightly.

drivers.member_snapshots.purpose: Daily membership statistics used to explain changes over time.
drivers.member_snapshots.lifecycle: Bounded history. MEMBER_SNAPSHOTS_KEEP_DAYS controls pruning; member deletion cascades.

drivers.player_battles.purpose: Individual battle records used for recent activity, wins and voyage contributions.
drivers.player_battles.lifecycle: Recent detail. Fold into daily summaries before deletion; BATTLE_RAW_KEEP_DAYS and BATTLE_PURGE_BATCH_ROWS control pruning.

drivers.player_battle_daily.purpose: Daily battle summaries that preserve useful totals after individual battles are removed.
drivers.player_battle_daily.lifecycle: Longer-lived aggregates. No age-based purge identified; player deletion cascades. Define the intended history horizon.

drivers.war_activity.purpose: Member participation and results for each war week.
drivers.war_activity.lifecycle: Domain history. Member deletion cascades; review whether a separate history horizon is required.

drivers.war_history.purpose: Completed clan war results and weekly performance.
drivers.war_history.lifecycle: Domain history. Define archival purpose and horizon rather than deleting by size alone.

drivers.war_opponents.purpose: Opponent clan information for war comparisons.
drivers.war_opponents.lifecycle: Domain reference data. Verify replacement and retirement behavior.

drivers.recruits.lifecycle: Bounded working set managed by rotation and stale, clanned and low-ranked candidate purges.

drivers.recruit_ledger.purpose: Recruitment events, invitations, dismissals and candidate movement.
drivers.recruit_ledger.lifecycle: Mixed history. purge_recruit_ledger prunes routine events but preserves selected user-action events indefinitely.

drivers.recruit_blacklist.purpose: Recruit dismissals and exclusions, including expiration dates.
drivers.recruit_blacklist.lifecycle: Exclusion state. purge_expired_blacklist removes expired rows.

drivers.exclusion_cache.purpose: Fast lookup of players excluded from recruit discovery.
drivers.exclusion_cache.lifecycle: Derived cache, synchronized by membership and blacklist triggers.

drivers.heritage_ledger.purpose: Recent membership continuity information used when members return.
drivers.heritage_ledger.lifecycle: Bounded domain history. purge_stale_heritage runs nightly.

drivers.clan_voyage.purpose: Scheduled, active and completed clan voyage state and targets.
drivers.clan_voyage.lifecycle: Voyage entities. Trigger-controlled jobs activate or finalize voyages; review completed voyage retirement.

drivers.clan_voyage_contributions.purpose: Per-player contributions to a voyage, including manual adjustments.
drivers.clan_voyage_contributions.lifecycle: Voyage detail. Voyage and player deletion cascade; consolidate history before deleting.

drivers.player_voyage_history.purpose: Consolidated player voyage totals used in scoring after voyage detail is removed.
drivers.player_voyage_history.lifecycle: Aggregated domain history. Player deletion cascades; stale history purge is a backstop.

drivers.push_subscriptions.lifecycle: Delivery state. Audit invalid endpoint eviction and owner removal; this inventory exports no subscription payloads.

features.player_card_snapshots.purpose: On-demand player card snapshots for the Laboratory.
features.player_card_snapshots.lifecycle: Refreshable cache. A freshness check is not an eviction policy; verify an explicit age or ownership bound.
